skill: Solving for a vector in a linear combination: isolate x in p a + q x = b, subtract the known scaled vector, divide componentwise by nonzero q, and return x or a requested sum/difference of two components.
reasoning_steps: Read coefficients including the sign of q and equal-length column vectors.
Isolate q x = b - p a and compute x=(b-p a)/q using componentwise arithmetic.
For scalar-target questions identify requested ordered indices and apply their sum or difference; select the matching choice among five.
response_contract: All 15 practice questions are easy radio selection with five math choices; vector questions ask a full 3D/4D vector, scalar questions ask a component sum/difference. Canonical example has no captured answer field.
difficulty: Easy: 3 or 4 components, small integer coefficients, nonzero q, integer solved components; no systems, dot products, nonlinear operations, or new free-entry requirement.
invariants: Equation uses one known vector a, one unknown vector x, and a known vector b of the same dimension.
Nonzero scalar coefficient of x ensures unique solution.
Prompt target, keyed answer, distractor bank, and worked arithmetic must agree.
Five distinct radio choices with exactly one correct response; original bank preserved for replay, allowing normalization of double-escaped captured TeX.
Preserve isolation/subtraction/division explanation; scalar targets add the requested component operation.
permitted_variations: Change p, signed nonzero q, vector entries and solved vector within comparable integer arithmetic workload.
Vary dimension between 3 and 4, positive/negative coefficients and zero/positive/negative components.
Vary vector versus scalar target and eligible ordered distinct component indices; sources x1+x2, x1-x2 and x3-x4 show target indices are answer-bearing assignments, not intrinsic fixed constraints.
Vary positions and plausible wrong choices without creating a bank-only cue to the correct option.

fixed_features.feature: one unknown vector and linear equation
fixed_features.justification: Defines the knowledge point and isolation method.
Observed easy examples uniformly use these; fractional and larger-dimensional workload not established.
Every captured practice answer contract has this form.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Both signs are demonstrated, so sign cannot be fixed globally.
Distinct indices among 3/4 components can change while preserving demonstrated operation.
No choice position, numerical rank, or coordinate-majority status is essential.
